title: 在训狗中学到的控制权与人性(4)
desc: 在训狗中学到的控制权与人性(4)

paragraphs.en: Everyone's search history contains a litany of guilty secrets.
paragraphs.zh: 每个人的搜索记录里，都藏着一些羞于启齿的秘密。

paragraphs.en: I confess that mine includes the words "boxer dog rehoming".
paragraphs.zh: 坦白说，我的搜索记录里有“拳师犬 重新安置”。

paragraphs.en: I've never done much more than Google it, mull it over, then shudder in horror at the imagined sight of Dusty's droopy face as I walked away from her for the last time.
paragraphs.zh: 我只是搜过，反复思索，一想到自己转身离开，留下达斯蒂耷拉着脸的画面，就一阵后怕。

paragraphs.en: But, yes, I have looked into it.
paragraphs.zh: 但没错，我确实查过。

paragraphs.en: The websites of dog rescue charities provide heartbreaking galleries of dogs that have been given up for one reason or another, often accompanied by the explanation that they find themselves there "through no fault of their own" (code for "they've not bitten anyone").
paragraphs.zh: 狗狗救助机构的网站上，满是令人心碎的狗狗照片，它们因为各种原因被弃养，介绍文字常常写着它们来到这里“并非自身过错”（潜台词就是：它们没有咬过人）。

paragraphs.en: When scrolling through the websites of boxer rescue charities, what stood out was the commonest age of the dogs: 14 months.
paragraphs.zh: 翻阅拳师犬救助网站时，我留意到这些狗狗最常见的弃养年龄：十四个月。

paragraphs.en: Dogs, like humans, go through an adolescence as they enter sexual maturation.
paragraphs.zh: 狗和人类一样，进入性成熟期时会经历青春期。

paragraphs.en: Symptoms can include a surge in energy, an independent streak in which they appear to have unlearned basic commands, and various other forms of behavioural regression, only now accompanied by an almost-adult body size.
paragraphs.zh: 表现包括精力暴涨，生出叛逆感，仿佛把学会的基础指令忘得一干二净，还有各类行为倒退。而此时，它们的体型已经接近成年犬。

paragraphs.en: Around Dusty's first birthday, our barely controllable dog became more than we could bear.
paragraphs.zh: 达斯蒂快一岁时，这只几乎无法管束的狗狗，让我们不堪重负。

paragraphs.en: If I had to pinpoint my lowest moment, it was probably at exactly 14 months.
paragraphs.zh: 如果要找出我最低谷的时刻，大概就是它十四个月大的时候。

paragraphs.en: Owners of small or unusually calm dogs barely notice their dog's adolescence.
paragraphs.zh: 养小型犬或是性格格外温顺狗狗的主人，几乎察觉不到狗狗的青春期。

paragraphs.en: Owners of larger, excitable breeds experience adolescence as the period when their dog becomes a complete arsehole, sprinting to random objects in the distance, seeming to develop a sixth sense for what you least want them to do and then doing it.
paragraphs.zh: 饲养大型、易兴奋犬种的主人会发现，青春期的狗狗变得十分难缠，会突然冲向远处各种东西，仿佛能感知到你最不想让它做什么，然后偏要去做。

paragraphs.en: In more paranoid moments, it's possible to believe that your adolescent dog has a vendetta against you.
paragraphs.zh: 心态敏感的时候，你甚至会觉得，青春期的狗狗存心和你作对。

paragraphs.en: Trainers recommend going "back to basics", which in Dusty's case meant trying and failing to reacquaint her with the word "sit", before she tore off in pursuit of a passing pigeon.
paragraphs.zh: 训犬师建议“回归基础训练”，放到达斯蒂身上，就是重新教它“坐下”。可还没教会，它就挣脱出去追逐路过的鸽子。

paragraphs.en: Where do you go once moral discipline is not on the menu and "positive reinforcement" feels inadequate?
paragraphs.zh: 当道德惩戒行不通，“正向强化”又感觉力有不逮时，还能去哪里寻找答案？

paragraphs.en: As in so many other areas of human and non-human life today, such queries eventually end up at nature's greatest control centre, the brain.
paragraphs.zh: 和如今人类与其他生物领域的很多难题一样，疑问最终指向大自然最核心的控制中枢：大脑。

paragraphs.en: It turns out that the adolescent dog's brain is a rich site for neurological speculation – of varying credibility.
paragraphs.zh: 青春期狗狗的大脑，催生了大量关于神经层面的猜想，可信度高低不一。

paragraphs.en: I've read that during this phase, synapses are being "rewired", that the part of the brain dealing with impulse control is temporarily weakened, that sexual hormones have thrown the brain into disequilibrium.
paragraphs.zh: 我读到，这个阶段突触正在“重新连接”，负责冲动控制的脑区功能暂时减弱，性激素打乱了大脑的平衡。

paragraphs.en: None of this is necessarily enough to discredit the notion that one's dog is actually an arsehole, but it does provide some help in getting to the end of another day without losing one's temper, which is maybe its real value.
paragraphs.zh: 这些说法未必能推翻“狗就是很捣蛋”的直观感受，但至少能帮人稳住情绪，熬过又一天而不发脾气，这或许才是它真正的价值。

paragraphs.en: The appeal of dog neuroscience is not limited to understanding their adolescence, indeed it kicks in as soon as you take a new puppy home.
paragraphs.zh: 犬神经科学的吸引力，不止用来解释青春期行为；事实上，从你把幼犬带回家那一刻起，这套理论就登场了。

paragraphs.en: Vets, trainers and dog charities all recite in unison that a puppy must encounter every sight, sound and sensation imaginable by the time they are 16 weeks old, or there is a risk that they will never get used to the experience in question.
paragraphs.zh: 兽医、训犬师、动物救助机构都会反复强调，幼犬必须在十六周大之前，接触所有能想象到的景象、声音与感官刺激，否则它可能永远无法适应这类体验。

paragraphs.en: This includes: vacuum cleaners, people in hi-vis clothing, pushchairs, people in funny hats and so on (various checklists exist to work through systematically).
paragraphs.zh: 包括吸尘器、穿反光背心的人、婴儿车、戴奇奇怪怪帽子的人等等（还有各类清单，可以按顺序逐一完成）。

paragraphs.en: A legacy of Covid is the surge in canine behavioural problems (including dog attacks) resulting from the large number of households acquiring puppies for the first time over 2020-21, which then had far less access to the outside world and other dogs.
paragraphs.zh: 新冠疫情留下一个后遗症：2020至2021年大量家庭第一次养幼犬，这些小狗接触外界和其他狗狗的机会太少，由此引发犬类行为问题（包括犬只攻击事件）激增。

paragraphs.en: I was filled with anxiety by the strictness of this 16-week window.
paragraphs.zh: 十六周这个时间窗口要求严苛，让我满心焦虑。

paragraphs.en: Would I need to take Dusty to every pub and cafe in east London before the cut-off?
paragraphs.zh: 我是不是要在截止日期前，带着达斯蒂走遍东伦敦每一家酒吧和咖啡馆？

paragraphs.en: Might I find a Village People tribute band, through which I could acquaint her with a full range of uniforms and hats all at once?
paragraphs.zh: 要不要找一个村民乐队致敬演出团体，一次性让它见识各式各样的制服和帽子？

paragraphs.en: But I was also a bit dubious.
paragraphs.zh: 但我也心存疑虑。

paragraphs.en: After a bit of research, I discovered that the precision of 16 weeks derived originally from one landmark study in the 1960s.
paragraphs.zh: 查阅资料后我发现，十六周这个精确时间点，最早来自上世纪六十年代一项里程碑式研究。

paragraphs.en: The magic number of 16 arose initially because the scientists had chosen (for reasons of experimental convenience) to split the puppies into an over-16-week group and an under-16-week group in order to compare them, and not because of any neurological discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 十六这个神奇数字，只是当年科学家出于实验便利，把幼犬分为十六周以上组和十六周以下组进行对比，并不是神经科学发现得出的结论。

paragraphs.en: The rule of 16 weeks does at least have the virtue of being a consensus.
paragraphs.zh: 十六周法则至少算是行业共识。

paragraphs.en: But in other cases where physiology and behaviour is concerned, part of the difficulty is the sheer range of conflicting opinions, products, theories and services, many of which are attached to lucrative businesses.
paragraphs.zh: 但在生理学与行为相关的其他领域，难点在于各类互相矛盾的观点、产品、理论和服务层出不穷，很多背后都是利润丰厚的商业项目。

paragraphs.en: As Dusty's behaviour deteriorated, we began to consider more veterinary explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 达斯蒂的行为越来越糟糕，我们开始考虑兽医层面的解释。

paragraphs.en: Was she in pain?
paragraphs.zh: 它是不是身体疼痛？

paragraphs.en: Was her brain being overwhelmed by urban life, as psychiatrists have wondered about human neurology at various points over the past 150 years?
paragraphs.zh: 是不是城市生活让它的大脑不堪重负，就像过去一百五十年里，精神科医生对人类神经系统产生过的种种猜想？

paragraphs.en: Turning to neurons as explanations has one indubitable merit: it relieves us of those feelings of responsibility and guilt that otherwise accompany a lack of control.
paragraphs.zh: 诉诸神经层面来解释，无疑有一个好处：可以卸下失控带来的责任感与愧疚。

paragraphs.en: There is no shortage of businesses willing to speculate on physiological drivers of canine behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 不少商家乐于从生理角度解读犬类行为。

paragraphs.en: Vet behaviourists will charge as much as ￡700 for a consultation.
paragraphs.zh: 兽医行为学家一次问诊收费高达700英镑。

paragraphs.en: Neurological diagnoses produce pharmaceutical solutions, and prescriptions for "Puppy Prozac" (fluoxetine) have increased tenfold over the past decade.
paragraphs.zh: 神经层面的诊断会带来药物方案，被叫做“幼犬百忧解”的氟西汀处方量，过去十年翻了十倍。

paragraphs.en: Britain's vet industry has belatedly become the focus of a Competition and Markets Authority investigation, no surprise to anyone who has paid ￡23 for one monthly anti-flea tablet.
paragraphs.zh: 英国兽医行业，终于受到竞争与市场管理局的调查。但凡花23英镑买过一粒月度体外驱虫药的人，对此都不会感到意外。

paragraphs.en: Dog ownership offers a glimpse of a society without universal, state-funded healthcare.
paragraphs.zh: 养狗这件事，让人窥见一个没有全民公费医疗的社会是什么样子。

paragraphs.en: It's not just the extraordinary expense that is draining, but the paranoid sense that there may be a solution out there, you just haven't yet paid enough for it.
paragraphs.zh: 令人心力交瘁的不只是高昂花费，还有一种挥之不去的猜想：或许有解决办法，只是你付的钱还不够。

paragraphs.en: Unable to speak for themselves, animals force us to adopt the approach of behavioural experimentation: we have nothing else to go on but what we can observe.
paragraphs.zh: 动物无法自述感受，我们只能采用行为实验的思路：除了观察到的表象，没有别的依据。

paragraphs.en: Of course we project our own lay interpretations and explanations on to that behaviour but when we remain baffled, stories about the brain fill the void.
paragraphs.zh: 我们当然会用普通人的理解去解读这些行为，但当我们百思不得其解时，关于大脑的各类说法就填补了这片空白。
